cards.mood: The piece opens with a serene, floating atmosphere that establishes a sense of vastness and solitude.
cards.vocal: A single female vocalist delivers the performance with an extremely soft, airy, and breathy timbre.
cards.palette: A grand piano with a felted, mellow tone serves as the harmonic backbone, playing slow, arpeggiated chords from the very beginning until the final fade.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a weightless, meditative stillness, establishing a sense of vast isolation.
